name: chezmoi-personal
description: Personal catalog of MCP servers, skills, and plugins for per-project opt-in install, curated from this dotfiles repo.

plugins.name: aws-local-dev
plugins.description: Registers the LocalStack MCP server (@localstack/localstack-mcp-server) for projects doing local AWS cloud development.

plugins.name: browser-tools
plugins.description: Registers the Playwright (@playwright/mcp) and Safari (safari-mcp) MCP servers for projects doing browser automation or testing.

plugins.name: openspec-dashboard
plugins.description: Registers the OpenSpec MCP server (openspec-mcp, with --with-dashboard) for projects using OpenSpec's spec-driven workflow.

plugins.name: serena
plugins.description: Registers the Serena MCP server (oraios/serena) for projects wanting semantic code analysis and LSP-based IDE assistance.

plugins.name: fast-filesystem
plugins.description: Registers the fast-filesystem MCP server (fast-filesystem-mcp) for projects wanting faster batch/bulk filesystem operations.

plugins.name: code-quality
plugins.description: Clean Code, refactoring patterns, clean architecture, software design philosophy, and pragmatic programming skills from wondelai/skills.

plugins.name: systems-design
plugins.description: Domain-driven design, designing data-intensive applications, and system design skills from wondelai/skills.

plugins.name: atlassian
plugins.description: Connect to Atlassian products including Jira and Confluence. Search and create issues, access documentation, manage sprints, and integrate your development workflow with Atlassian's collaboration tools. MCP server and skills from atlassian/atlassian-mcp-server.

plugins.name: aws-core
plugins.description: Build, deploy, and operate applications on AWS. Skills to author infrastructure-as-code, use core services, and complete common tasks. From aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws.

plugins.name: cloudflare
plugins.description: Skills for the Cloudflare developer platform: Workers, Durable Objects, Agents SDK, MCP servers, Wrangler CLI, and web performance. From cloudflare/skills.
